title: Wide Poster Maker — Print Big Posters on A4 & Letter
description: Split any image or PDF across multiple A4 or US Letter sheets with crop marks, glue overlap tabs, and an assembly map. 100% private in your browser.
lead: Split any image or PDF into a multi-page printable PDF for A4, US Letter, A3, or Legal home printers — with crop marks, glue tabs, and zero uploads.

sections.heading: Print Wall-Sized Posters Without a Plotter
paragraphs: Most home printers stop at A4 or US Letter, while copy shops charge extra for wide-format plotting. WidePosterMaker slices high-resolution photos, illustrations, CAD drawings, maps, and oversized PDFs into an exact tile grid you can print on standard office paper and assemble cleanly in minutes.
Unlike cloud converters, your files never leave your computer. Images are embedded once and PDFs are clipped as sharp vector XObjects directly in browser memory.
sections.listHeading: How It Works in Three Steps
list: Drop or paste any PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, or PDF file (multi-page PDFs let you pick any page).
Choose A4 or US Letter paper, Auto orientation, target poster size or sheet count, printer margin, and glue overlap.
Download the tiled PDF, print at 100% / Actual Size, trim the white borders, and glue along the overlap crosshairs.

sections.heading: Standard Poster Sizes & Home Printer Sheet Counts
paragraphs: Use this reference when planning wall art, classroom charts, or event banners. The counts are calculated with the same geometry the tool uses, including the printer margin and the glue overlap, so they are what you will actually print.

faqs.q: Are my images or PDFs uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. WidePosterMaker runs 100% locally inside your browser using JavaScript ES modules. Even after the page loads, zero file data leaves your computer.

faqs.q: Why should I download the PDF instead of printing directly from a web page?
faqs.a: Browsers frequently apply inconsistent CSS print scaling across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari. Generating a true millimeter-accurate PDF lets you verify the 50 mm / 2 in calibration ruler and print at 100% Actual Size from any PDF viewer.

faqs.q: How do glue overlap tabs and alignment crosshairs work?
faqs.a: Each interior sheet retains an overlap strip along its right and bottom edges marked with dashed guide lines and corner (+) crosshairs. Trim the top and left margins of the next sheet and align its clean edge right onto the crosshairs.

faqs.q: Can I skip completely blank outer sheets to save ink and paper?
faqs.a: Yes. Click any tile cell directly in the interactive preview grid to mark it as skipped before generating your final PDF.
